product_overview: Antigravity Kit is a modular AI agent capability expansion toolkit providing a composable system with specialist AI personas, skills, and workflows to empower diverse development and administrative tasks within a web application. The system includes authentication, school and user management, educational planning, and a powerful administrative interface.
core_goals: Enable seamless user authentication with custom auto-login for specialized domains.
Provide comprehensive administrative tools for managing schools, users, and system settings.
Facilitate efficient school data integration and management.
Support individualized development plans (PDI) management for students.
Offer lesson planning and curriculum simulation capabilities.
Ensure modular and scalable architecture supporting AI specialist agents, skills, and workflows for extensibility and maintainability.
key_features: User authentication via Supabase Auth including custom auto-login flows.
Admin Panel for managing schools, users, and system-wide settings.
School Management services integrating and managing school data.
Individual Development Plan (PDI) management features for monitoring student progress.
Planning features including lesson planning, curriculum management, and simulation workspace.
Modular AI system composed of 20 specialist agents and 36 domain skills for enhanced functionality.
Slash command workflows to facilitate common development and operation tasks.
user_flow_summary: User visits the login screen and authenticates via Supabase Auth, potentially auto-logging in on specialized domains.
Authenticated users access the dashboard with navigation to administration, school management, plans, and simulations.
Administrators use the Admin Panel to manage schools, user accounts, and system settings.
Teachers and planners create and manage Individual Development Plans and lesson plans using the Planning and PDI modules.
Users can simulate lesson plans and curriculum scenarios in the simulation workspace to optimize educational delivery.
The modular AI agents and workflows operate behind the scenes to assist and automate development, testing, deployment, and debugging processes.
validation_criteria: Authentication flow works securely and supports custom auto-login for special domains.
Admin Panel functions correctly, allowing management of schools, users, and settings without errors.
School data is correctly integrated, stored, and managed through the school management services.
Individual Development Plans (PDI) can be created, read, updated, and deleted effectively.
Planning module supports creation, adjustment, and simulation of lesson plans with responsive UI.
System passes master validation scripts checklist.py and verify_all.py ensuring code quality, security, UX, and SEO.
End-to-end tests covering user login, admin tasks, school management, planning, and PDI features pass successfully.
Performance profiling confirms responsiveness and scalability under typical user loads.
